summary: Tested Plume Astrale /livres refonte (PhysicalBookScene 6 real book covers), hover halo, mobile responsiveness, admin QR stats dashboard, and backend endpoints (/api/admin/referral-scan-stats, /api/pdf/download?print_ready=1). All 7 targeted features PASS. Two non-blocking issues identified: (1) Low contrast on /admin/qr-stats page - light cream text on light PsPageShell background; (2) React 'duplicate key' console warning on /livres.

minor.issue: Supabase table 'referral_scan_counters' missing → endpoint soft-fails with {ok:false, error:'PGRST205'}. Endpoint code handles it gracefully (returns 200), but frontend renders qr-stats-error banner instead of qr-stats-empty. Consider creating the table or treating PGRST205 as empty in the endpoint.

issues: Text color #F5EEE0 (cream) on PsPageShell light background → very low contrast on the title 'Scans QR de parrainage', KPI cards labels, and subtitle. The page uses dark-theme colors while rendered inside a light shell. Fix: either pass background='dark' to PsPageShell or use dark ink colors (#1a1a2e-ish) matching the site's light theme.

console_warnings.issue: React 'Encountered two children with the same key' warning printed 3× on mount. Likely inside PsPageShell/navbar/footer rather than the BOOKS map (each book has unique slug). Worth grep-ing for map() without key or with duplicate keys.

backend_curl./api/admin/referral-scan-stats?top=50: HTTP 200, {ok:false, error:'PGRST205 table missing', top_codes:[]} - soft-fail as designed
backend_curl./api/pdf/download?session_id=fake&token=: HTTP 404 'Transaction introuvable' - signature accepts print_ready (NOT 422, NOT 500 - no regression)

action_items: Fix contrast on /admin/qr-stats: the page uses dark-theme colors (#F5EEE0, #B9B0D5) but is wrapped in PsPageShell default (light) - either pass background='dark' or invert colors to dark ink.
Fix React duplicate-key warning on /livres (3 warnings on mount) - not in BOOKS map (slugs unique), likely in navbar/shell/footer.

Optional: create Supabase table 'referral_scan_counters' (code text pk, count int, updated_at timestamptz) OR make the endpoint return {ok:true, top_codes:[]} when PGRST205 (table missing) so UI shows empty state instead of error banner.
critical_code_review_comments: PhysicalBookScene.js gracefully handles image error via onError opacity=0 - good defensive pattern.
AdminQrStats.js correctly does client-side redirect via <Navigate to='/'/> for non-admin; uses session.access_token from AuthContext - clean.
qr_referral_tracker.py: soft-fail catch is broad but appropriate for a best-effort analytics endpoint. Consider narrowing exception + treating PGRST205 specifically as empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /livres refonte with PhysicalBookScene is fully working - 6 real cover PNGs load with naturalWidth=1200, hover halo transform scale(1.55) confirmed via computed style, CTAs navigate to product pages, mobile has no horizontal overflow. Admin dashboard /admin/qr-stats is functional but the Supabase table 'referral_scan_counters' does not exist yet - endpoint soft-fails to {ok:false} and UI renders error state (not empty state). Contrast issue on that page: dark-theme colors on light shell. Backend param print_ready is properly typed as bool - no 422 regression.
